resolved_findings.resolution: Environment.start now samples an optional pair of Created Unit and E through ordinary uniform effects. program passes that exact Created value through a private initialization request unavailable to EnvEffects, initializes env execution from the paired E, ends with none on startup failure, and obtains the ledger Server ID from the same Created value. Frame now bounds startup uniform calls.

Public hash is excluded from IsEnvironment and native dispatches it directly to Capability.hash. Both public and environment-requested hash work therefore reach the same capability interpreter; its future shared-cache equation remains explicit.

Guide now explicitly requires ticket binding to slot, owner, phase/generation, expected sender, AD and retained kernel; changed pinned sender and AD are rejected; direct installation rejects role-tag mismatch; advanceOwner cannot reset an established kernel.
candidateReply_some and the guide now describe preservation of a supplied sequence-one optional plaintext and explicitly defer source provenance to the missing interpreter simulation.

The proposal consistently identifies itself as an unfrozen type/open-program proposal, says no probabilistic RecordLift.game exists yet, and leaves concrete interpreter, installation invariants, source simulation, ideal games and security results open. Approval is restricted to this provisional scope.
Frame remains solely a startup/per-command resource condition. It does not assume secrecy, independence, noninterference, freshness, small refusal probability or game-distance bounds.
